365:t_5:20.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「That's right. Whoever would do something like manipulate people's hearts is the one to blame.」

365:t_5:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「The problem is what comes next.」

365:t_5:22.en:
$$カレン$$
「What's going to happen to Miss $$スズネ$$...?」

365:t_5:23.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Not that it's any comfort, but I'm sure she's safe.」

365:t_5:24.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Isn't that the most important thing?!」

365:t_5:25.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Yeah! If that's certain, then we can just take her back!」

365:t_5:26.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't forget. We're dealing with $$バルビエル$$, remember.」

365:t_5:28.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm sure he'll... use Miss $$スズネ$$ to damage $n's heart...」

365:t_5:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「So he's gotten his hands on the ultimate weapon...」

365:t_5:31.en:
$$甲児$$
「He asked to be left alone... He's in his room.」

365:t_5:33.en:
$$メール$$
「$n... I wonder if he can pull through...」

365:t_5:34.en:
$$ランド$$
「He's a strong guy. I'm sure he'll...」

365:t_5:35.en:
$$メール$$
「...But $n lost his father and his big sister in an accident...」

365:t_5:37.en:
$$メール$$
「He's been fighting the pain of losing people who mattered to him all this time... And if something like this happens again...」

365:t_5:40.en:
$n
「...So you were all here. I've been looking for you.」

365:t_5:42.en:
$n
「Could someone run a simulation with me? Ideally $$カミーユ$$ or $$スザク$$, since they're good at close combat...」

365:t_5:43.en:
$$アルト$$
「...Are you sure you're all right?」

365:t_5:44.en:
$n
「...I can't say yes with total confidence.」

365:t_5:46.en:
$n
「You're desperately trying to save $$千鳥$$ too... And so am I...」

365:t_5:47.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Got it. ...$$スザク$$, lend me a hand too.」

365:t_5:50.en:
$$カレン$$
「Me too...! If you want close-combat partners, I'll go ask $$デュオ$$, $$カトル$$, and $$竜馬$$ too!」

365:t_5:53.en:
$$キラ$$
「If Miss $$スズネ$$ were here, she'd surely say that's what's good about $n.」

365:t_5:54.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Geez... If it's combat training you want, don't forget about my Systema.」

365:t_5:55.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$セツコ$$... When it comes to training, this is your time to shine.」

365:t_5:57.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Somebody once said it, but watching him makes my short-straw luck act up.」

365:t_5:58.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's not limited to you guys.」

365:t_5:59.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah... Seeing that quiet-type profile of his, somehow I can't leave him alone.」

365:t_5:60.en:
$$甲児$$
「I bet Miss $$スズネ$$ felt just like this when she looked after him.」

365:t_5:61.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'd guess $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ was the same.」

365:t_5:63.en:
$$アマタ$$
「All that's left is how $$バルビエル$$ will make his move.」

365:t_5:64.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We all have a score to settle with that man.」

365:t_5:65.en:
$$カレン$$
「No matter what underhanded trick he pulls using Miss $$スズネ$$, we won't lose to him!」

365:t_5:66.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$バルビエル$$... I'll be the one to deliver the finishing blow...)

365:t_5:67.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I've started to understand, just a little... why you're after me...)

365:t_5:71.en: ～ $$ターミナル・ベース$$, Research Facility ～

365:t_5:72.en:
$$桂$$
「...Is this where they used you as a lab rat?」

365:t_5:73.en:
$$オルソン$$
「The treatment wasn't all that bad.」

365:t_5:74.en:
$$オルソン$$
「It seems $$サイデリアル$$ was trying to use me for something, as the $$特異点$$ at the beginning of the multiverse.」

365:t_5:75.en:
$$桂$$
「But $$時空修復|lc$$ is impossible, isn't it?」

365:t_5:77.en:
$$桂$$
「I played a role like yours under Dr. $$トライア$$, you see.」

365:t_5:78.en:
$$オルソン$$
「So that's where you learned it...」

365:t_5:79.en:
$$桂$$
「Yeah... ...Repairing the multiverse as it is now, multilayered by a chain of $$時空震動|lc$$s, is practically impossible...」

365:t_5:80.en:
$$オルソン$$
「If it were forced through anyway, it would be the same as destroying every parallel world...」

365:t_5:81.en:
$$桂$$
「...That said, apparently I'm nowhere near strong enough on my own to affect the convergence point of today's dimensional boundary lines.」

365:t_5:82.en:
$$桂$$
「I figured if the universe's collapse once every 12,000 years was a spacetime disaster, I'd be the trump card...」

365:t_5:83.en:
$$桂$$
「Turns out the crisis closing in isn't a once-in-12,000-years thing but a once-in-120-million-years one, and I'm totally powerless against it.」

365:t_5:84.en:
$$オルソン$$
「So you had gotten hold of that information too...」

365:t_5:85.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$ is really something. Even $$サイデリアル$$, whose super-dimensional physics is several steps ahead of Earth's, apparently reached the same conclusion.」

365:t_5:86.en:
$$オルソン$$
「It seems that even with your power and mine together, we'd still lack the factors for $$時空修復|lc$$.」

365:t_5:89.en:
$$桂$$
「...Sometimes I wonder. If I hadn't set off the $$時空震動弾|lc$$ back then, what would have become of the world...」

365:t_5:90.en:
$$オルソン$$
「...You'd probably have married $$ティナ$$, and to $$アテナ$$, I'd have been just a friend of her father's.」

365:t_5:91.en:
$$桂$$
「Meaning I'd never have met $$ミムジィ$$.」

365:t_5:92.en:
$$オルソン$$
「And the world would have gone on fighting pointless wars...」

365:t_5:93.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Maybe the people who built the $$時空震動弾|lc$$ were fed up with a world like that.」

365:t_5:95.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Even $$チラム$$, twenty years after that, couldn't complete a $$時空震動弾|lc$$...」

365:t_5:97.en:
$$オルソン$$
「That $$時空震動弾|lc$$ had a lot of inexplicable points... I did try probing into it back when I was a $$チラム$$ soldier.」

365:t_5:99.en:
$$オルソン$$
「I couldn't learn anything about how it was developed. The $$時空震動|lc$$ had wiped out all the old records.」

365:t_5:100.en:
$$桂$$
「Looking to the future beats looking back at the past. ...I'm counting on you again, $$オルソン$$.」

365:t_5:101.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Yeah... I don't plan on dying until I get to meet $$アテナ$$.」
